runs.text: Trail running, wheel-thrown ceramics and a monthly sci-fi book club

• Hired and mentored three product managers
• Owned the shipment tracking experience across web, iOS and Android
• Cut “where is my order” support tickets by 37% with proactive alerts
• Introduced a quarterly discovery ritual adopted by four other teams
• Shipped savings goals, the bank’s most-used feature within six months
• Ran 40+ A/B tests on the account-opening flow (+12% completion)
University of Washington, Foster School of Business
